authorization: Connection, installation, discovery, model output and deployment authorization confer no runtime write authority. Each effect/retry requires trusted source closure, current principal/profile/generation, recipient clearance, exact action and normalized digest, finite task scope and fresh one-use grant. UNKNOWN remains private; no public/private or budget fallback. Root fresh authoritative System direct/indirect membership required for homelab writes; financial execution uses separate explicit user-order authority.
confirmation: Trusted human review attestation bound to exact final action payload, principal/account/recipient/operation/target/generation/digest/policy/nonce/expiry. Financial TTL at most300s, single consume before effect; no standing/wildcard consent or caller confirm boolean. Destructive/admin/overwrite operations additionally require manifest-specified explicit confirmation and provider scope. Changes require new attestation.
idempotency: Durable root ledger keyed principal, adapter, account/target, generation, action, canonical digest and idempotency key. Atomically reserve before effect; record pending/committed/ambiguous and returned operation ID. Unknown outcome forbids blind retry, reconciles via fixed read then obtains fresh authority. Provider lacking idempotency is not made idempotent by a fixture.
bounds: Root schema selects finite request/response/time/concurrency limits per action before enrollment; missing schema or limit leaves action unavailable. No wildcard action, arbitrary URL/path/argv/proxy, secret output, unapproved redirect or automatic external write.
evidence: EV-RB08 requires actual native plugin dispatch through protected enrolled handler and backend plus wrong peer/profile/account/action/digest/generation/credential scope, forged confirmation, replay/parallel duplicate/ambiguous outcome, private recipient and cancellation negatives. Inventory/schema and mocked effects prove only their corresponding dimensions; target/account acceptance remains open. No live trades/spend/faucet/outbound test messaging.

special_constraints.finance: Read hub cannot execute/pay/sign. Live wallet locally generated encrypted root custody, exact selected network/transaction/fee/calldata and simulation plus user order; no key/seed export or user wallet import. Sandbox only ethereum-sepolia/solana-devnet, no real-value route or mainnet bridge. Fresh one-shot final-payload confirmation and actual hardware confirmation for Ledger.
special_constraints.accounts: GitHub least privilege task-scoped writes plus verifyAfterWrite; Composio per-user/profile pinned toolkit/version/action allowlist, no workbench/bash/proxy; Codex assigned workspace/runtime only, root-managed shared auth and no credential copy/export or implicit infrastructure authority.
special_constraints.homelab: Finite selected service/host/account/zone/DNS/tunnel actions only, no raw SSH/shell/occ/docker/systemd/caller path. Authentik read-only current authority, no group/user mutation; preserve unrelated resources. Manifest hostnames are runtime allowlist candidates, never installer hostname prefill or account enrollment.
special_constraints.documents: Managed fixed tool/recipe and owned output root, no arbitrary shell/DRM/source overwrite. EPUB validation before delivery. Kobo actual device/backend capability selected, explicit user delivery and overwrite confirmation, no purchase/DRM/credential scraping/notebook writes.
special_constraints.local_voice_web: Epic ephemeral board is internal correlation, never authority, accepted lifecycle before delete. Overlay owner-only/private atomic versions/encrypted backup, no cross-user/network export/git sync/capability expansion. Voice session-authorized microphone, fixed local endpoints/no raw persistence/cloud fallback; wakeword not authorization. Web read-only public URLs selected by trusted task and root validation; HTTPS/TLS/public-address/redirect/size/timeout validation, no credentials/authenticated actions/executable download. User query/URL is data, not authority; no generic proxy.

request_fields: arguments (exact enrolled argument_schema_id; extra fields forbidden)
wire.authorization: Separate opaque verified host context and single-use effect authorization; never caller sensitivity/role/credential claims
wire.recipient: Exact protected recipient field; caller cannot choose, widen or override
wire.larger_binary_output: Owned immutable artifact handle with separately authorized bounded reads; no unbounded inline binary or caller output path

delete_accepted.result: verified archive/deletion receipt; caller accepted bool forbidden

voice_transcribe.result: bounded transcript and root source receipt; fixed mode maps to selected Whisper or Speech-to-Phrase; transcript/wakeword not action authority

arguments.session_handle: root enrolled active local output session

voice_speak.result: owned bounded audio artifact receipt; no raw path/cloudfallback

arguments.title: bounded plain text<=256chars
arguments.recipe_id: opaque root selected managed build recipe

run.result: typed artifact receipt plus validation_status=valid|invalid|unsupported and bounded validation_report artifact; invalid EPUB not deliverable

validate.result: validation_status and owned bounded report receipt

arguments.book_id: opaque selected owned device notebook/book ID
arguments.enrollment_id: opaque root-selected actual compatible device/backend generation

read.result: owned notebook export artifact receipt and provenance; no password/scrape/DRM

deliver.result: operation_id plus verified device destination receipt; explicit runtime user delivery and one-shot confirmation before any overwrite

schema_rule: Additional argument fields forbidden. IDs resolve current root principal/profile/generation and cannot encode paths/URLs/commands. These facade action schemas are not guessed upstream endpoint schemas; protected selected backend handler must separately validate source-reviewed API mapping. Unsupported requested original actions remain explicit incomplete.
